subject: Hosted API evaluation - demo scheduling
messages:
From: Sara Patel <sara@atlas.ai>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T15:12:00-07:00
Subject: Hosted API evaluation — Interested in a demo

Hi Marissa,

We signed up for the Hosted API last week and have been running some quick tests. The latency and quality look promising — we'd like to schedule a short demo/eval session to understand:
- Production performance characteristics (p95 latency, cold start behavior)
- Pricing and committed options for sustained usage
- Best practices for batching and caching with our prompt patterns

We're evaluating for a personalization pipeline (low-latency inference, ~50 qps peak, mostly short prompts). Would love a 30-minute walkthrough plus a brief tech Q&A with an SE if possible. My availability next week (PST):
- Tue 2026-03-09: 9–11am or 3–5pm
- Wed 2026-03-10: 10–12pm

Do you have any standard pre-demo materials we can share with the product team?

Thanks,
Sara Patel
Product Manager, Atlas AI
@sara_at_atlas

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
To: Sara Patel <sara@atlas.ai>
Cc: Dev Patel <dev_patel@redwood.ai>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-03-02T17:04:00-07:00
Subject: Re: Hosted API evaluation — Demo scheduling

Hi Sara — thanks for reaching out and congrats on getting started with the Hosted API! Happy to set up a 30-minute demo to cover performance, pricing, and SE Q&A.

Proposed slots (PST):
- Tue 2026-03-09 10:00–10:30
- Tue 2026-03-09 15:30–16:00
- Wed 2026-03-10 10:30–11:00

If any of those work, I’ll send a calendar invite. I’ve CC’d Dev (SE) and Aditya (AE) so they can join the technical and commercial parts.

Attached is a short demo agenda and our one-pager on pricing to help your team prepare: redwood-hosted-api-demo-agenda-v2.pdf; redwood-pricing-onepager.pdf

Quick ask to help tailor the demo: can you confirm expected average request size (tokens) and whether you’ll need streaming responses or function-calling in your flow?

Calendar link: https://redwood.ai/meet/6h7g9k (pick a time and we’ll lock it)

Best,
Marissa Cole
SDR, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.ai
https://www.redwood.ai

Thanks Marissa — and thanks for including Dev and Aditya. Quick update: the product lead on our side has a conflict on Tue afternoon. Could we move to Wed 2026-03-10 at 10:30–11:00? That slot should work for our team.

For prep: average prompt + response ~350 tokens; streaming not required for this use case. We may want to discuss batching strategies since some requests will be sub-100 tokens and we care about tail latency.

- 0–8m: Intro & use-case overview (Atlas AI)
- 8–18m: Hosted API demo — latency, batching, caching, and perf profiles
- 18–26m: SE Q&A (Dev) — integration, KV cache, quantization notes
